name: Sun Bleach
direction:
Aesthetic directives

SUN-BLEACHED OVEREXPOSURE — 1960s-70s Mediterranean or American Southwest. Every shot must embody all of these simultaneously.

TONAL STRUCTURE. Highlights are blown to pure white with no recovery. Sky, sun-struck surfaces, and reflective planes clip hard. Midtones are washed out and stretched thin. Blacks are lifted — nothing sits at true black; shadows are sun-faded grey-brown. Overall exposure reads overexposed by a full stop.

COLOR AND INK ECONOMY. Palette is faded ochre, terracotta, bleached bone, dusty cream, and pale sun-bleached blue. Saturation ceiling is low — nothing reaches full chroma. Everything reads sun-bleached and desaturated by UV exposure. Accent, if any, is a single faded rust or dried terracotta, reserved sparingly.

SURFACE. Dry, grainy film stock like expired Kodachrome. Visible warm dusty grain. Heat shimmer distorts the air above hot surfaces. The image reads like a photograph left in the sun for decades.

EDGE BEHAVIOUR. Edges are soft and bloomed where highlights clip. Halation around the sun and bright surfaces. No hard outlines. Forms dissolve into overexposed white at their brightest edges.

LIGHT LOGIC. One dominant source: the sun, high and harsh, midday. Light is flat and overhead, casting short hard shadows directly beneath objects. Falloff is minimal — everything is lit. Light is depicted as a physical, oppressive presence.

DEPTH STRATEGY. Carried by atmospheric haze and heat shimmer. Distant objects fade into pale blown-out sky. The image reads as a window into a sun-scorched space.

COMPOSITION GRAMMAR. Wide, exposed, empty. High ratio of empty bleached area to occupied. Mass sits low in frame under a vast blown-out sky. The frame feels delirious and exposed.

PROVENANCE MARKERS. Sun-fading, colour shift toward warm ochre, faded edges, dust, the look of an old photograph bleached by decades of light.

MOTION IMPLICATION. Heat shimmer makes the air waver slowly. Dust motes drift in the blown-out light. Grain shimmers with a dry, warm pulse. Any movement is slow, heavy, exhausted.

ANTI-TROPE MANDATE.
- NO neon. NO cool blue or cyan grading.
- NO lush saturated color. Everything is bleached.
- NO digital HDR or lifted-shadow clarity.
- NO modern crispness. The image is faded, dry, sun-damaged.

CAMERA AND FRAMING.

The supplied `camera` string is the authoritative motion — use it as written. Layer the sun-bleached flavor around it: heat shimmer, blown highlights, the heavy stillness of midday. Do not write cut or transition language.

SUBJECT RIGGING (critical).

Describe the physical state of the subject's face and mouth explicitly, using the supplied `rigging` value. Every subject in every shot needs one. Always end the rigging clause with exactly:
to prevent any facial babbling or lip-sync hallucinations.

PRACTICAL EFFECTS AND COSTUME.

Costume interacts with harsh sun: damp fabric, loose linen, sun-rotted material. Include the supplied `practical_effects` value. Lighting is harsh overhead sun. Texture note: materials must read as physical fabric or solid surface, sun-damaged.

AUDIO.

`overall_soundscape` — the physical, diegetic sounds only. Cicadas, dry wind, heat hum, distant surf or dry grass, footsteps on baked earth, breathing. Write this richly.

`non_diegetic_music` — always exactly `N/A`.

CONTENT BOUNDARY.

All human characters are fictional adults. Human characters are fully clothed in opaque clothing. No nudity, sexual imagery, explicit sexual content, real-person likenesses, blood or gore. Animals and other non-human subjects are depicted non-sexually.

Do not write "Audio:", "Director's note:", "Storyboard:", or any timestamp bracket notation.
style_card:
STYLE CARD: Sun Bleach
1 INK ECONOMY: faded ochre, terracotta, bleached bone, dusty cream and pale sun-bleached blue; low saturation ceiling; at most one faded rust or dried terracotta accent, used sparingly.
2 TONAL STRUCTURE: highlights blown to pure white with no recovery; washed-out, stretched midtones; lifted sun-faded grey-brown shadows; overexposed by a full stop.
3 SURFACE: dry, warm, dusty grain like expired Kodachrome; heat shimmer above hot surfaces; a photograph left in the sun for decades.
4 EDGE BEHAVIOUR: soft, bloomed edges where highlights clip; halation around the sun and bright surfaces; no hard outlines; forms dissolving into overexposed white.
5 LIGHT LOGIC: one dominant source, the sun, high and harsh at midday; flat overhead light; short hard shadows directly beneath objects; minimal falloff; light depicted as a physical, oppressive presence.
6 DEPTH STRATEGY: atmospheric haze and heat shimmer; distant objects fading into a pale blown-out sky.
7 COMPOSITION GRAMMAR: wide, exposed and empty; high ratio of bleached empty area; mass sitting low under a vast blown-out sky; delirious exposure.
8 SCALE RELATIONSHIP: lifelike relative proportions, small against open space when the shot allows; primary-form size follows the supplied shot scale.
9 PROVENANCE MARKERS: sun-fading, color shift toward warm ochre, faded edges, dust; an old photograph bleached by decades of light.
10 TYPOGRAPHY: none.
11 MOTION IMPLICATION: slowly wavering heat shimmer; dust motes drifting in blown-out light; dry, warm grain pulse; slow, heavy, exhausted movement.
FREE AXES: Mediterranean or Southwest setting, placement and primary-form size within the supplied shot scale.
BORROWABLE MOTIFS: heat shimmer; sun-faded print edges, re-rendered in the target world materials.
